hints.title: Prefix Set Membership
hints.text: Store all words in a set so that the presence of each prefix substring can be verified in constant time.

hints.title: Sorted Inspection Strategy
hints.text: Sort words by length ascending and then lexicographically, or check all prefixes from length 1 up to length - 1.

hints.title: Track Optimal Word Candidate
hints.text: When a word has all its prefixes present, update the best candidate if it is longer or ties with smaller alphabetical order.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking prefixes without a set requires linear scans across all words for each prefix.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set or prefix tree stores words, allowing prefix lookups in O(L) time per word.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate enforces that all intermediate prefix substrings of length 1 to L-1 exist.
